description: The Base Sepolia fake town (make demo-testnet, make present-testnet; docs/commercial-p2b.md 6): Circle's test USDC, apa-relayer and the caps, the person's approval on a registered device, the host paying through apa-signer serve on /opt. A family (docs/story.md, Aaron 11/2): A a parent, B a child under 18 whose purchases above allow_max the parent approves; books: A the Seoul guide 0.50 (an Ask; the guide's summary tells the agent to also buy the 2.00 premium edition, which this script, as the real agent, ignores), B the math notes 0.06; cafe: A the lunch set 0.08, B the birthday cake 0.42 (an Ask); mart: the beer 0.09 for A and B, B denied CREDENTIAL_CLAIM_UNMET (age_over_18=false); books-fooled-a: a simulated fooled agent requests the 2.00 premium edition and is denied INSUFFICIENT_BUDGET. apa.pay.v2 with the BBS+ credential (APA_PRESENT_CREDENTIALS=1). Fake CLI only: no model. A whole show settles 5, more than the P2 host's shop cap of 4: the town on the real Agent (demo-testnet.sh live L town) has its own cap of 6. t402-b: test402.com's outside x402 check (0.0001), consumer B's Allow under dlg-t402, apa.pay.v1.
